reason: B is the stronger proposal because it extends a demonstrated graphene crack-arrest mechanism to a caloric MM′X-type alloy and provides measurable mechanical and caloric falsification criteria, whereas A largely transplants the cited 3 vol% Al2O3 intervention and its reported ~21% strength gain while overlooking the associated loss of plasticity.
